hero.title: Someone will write at 11:40 tonight
hero.lede: Tracking and returns keep running after you close. If something needs a person, the customer gets a straight answer about when you're back.

image.alt: A person looking at a phone in a dark room at night.

dayDial.title: The day on one dial
lede: Fernway's team works nine to six on weekdays, shown in green. The dots stand for messages arriving through the day.

nightMessage.title: An angry message at night
lede: Complaints skip the automation and go to a person. After hours, the customer is told when that will be.

items.title: Your opening hours
items.text: You enter them in Business profile. Fernway's are Monday to Friday 9:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 10:00 to 16:00.

items.title: The first flow on the list
items.text: Complaints and after hours runs first, so an upset customer never gets a cheerful bot.

items.title: The widget's own line
items.text: It says "AI assistant now, people back tomorrow at 9 am", worked out from those hours.

stopAtSix.title: You get to stop at six
stopAtSix.lede: In the morning, the board shows what happened overnight and what's waiting for you.
